text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well, I think that's enough walking for now. …Oh?

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Oooh, that'll bruise… O-oh! I don't suppose you could lend me a hand?! I've gone and taken a tumble on the way back from my shopping run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …?! Oh no… Here, take my hand. I shall see you back to your residence.

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Well, aren't you a kind young lady. Care to come in for a cup of tea?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I would be most delighted. However, I must insist on treating your injuries first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Do you have any bandages in your medicine cabinet? Also, would you mind if I used your kitchen to prepare an herbal salve—

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh deary, you don't need to be going to all that trouble for little old me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's quite all right… Sitting idle while another's suffering is something I simply cannot do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps because she put so much effort into helping the older lady, Mejiro Ardan is looking fatigued.
